story_position: Chapter 3 — Beat 8 — Archive Scribe Engine / Nimera Joins
scene_purpose: Pay off the reactivated deeper Archive with the first hostile Scribe Engine response; let Nimera voluntarily enter combat and demonstrate her Cardweaver/Conduit identity; establish the first four-person permanent-member battle shape; follow with a bounded evidence review that preserves all later Card and royal-seal reveals; then have Nimera explicitly choose to continue with the group, making this the permanent recruitment point.

sections: Beat 8 — Archive Scribe Engine / Nimera Joins

scene_context_seed.location_name: deeper Old City archive immediately beyond reopened Ancient barrier
scene_context_seed.runtime_note: Ancient archive machinery is physical magical craft: fitted stone, metal, engraved channels, scribing arms, record drums, shutters, rails, styluses, seals and enchanted inlay. Do not use software/network/interface language. Keep pre-fight and post-fight dialogue concise; the encounter itself carries the center of the Beat.

required_story_beats: The newly reconnected deeper Archive produces a hostile Archive Scribe Engine response directly connected to the reopened route.
The Scribe Engine reads as an old archive/transcription/enforcement mechanism, not a villain or speaking character.
Nimera voluntarily enters the combat formation without being ordered or rescued again.
The battle party is Cyanis, Ilyra, Torren and Nimera; no reserve-management tutorial is required.
Nimera's combat presentation visibly uses her Cardweaver identity, Cards and Conduit equipment under existing combat authority.
The Scribe Engine is disabled without a large destruction spectacle or broad Old City shutdown.
After combat, Nimera inspects surviving mechanism evidence, Cyanis's Card and the permitted royal-seal comparison material.
Nimera confirms the Card is meaningfully abnormal and organized but refuses Prime, Might, Last Sentinel, bearer or ownership conclusions.
The group recognizes that deeper archive material remains the best next evidence source.
Cyanis makes clear that continuing is Nimera's choice, not an assignment, debt, prophecy or magical compulsion.
Nimera explicitly chooses to continue the investigation with the group.
Nimera Pellan permanently joins the party after that choice.
The permanent active combat party becomes Cyanis, Ilyra, Torren and Nimera.
Handoff proceeds into Beat 9 deeper four-person archive exploration.
production_cost_ceiling: short pre-fight trigger plus one mandatory battle plus concise post-fight evidence/recruitment scene
